faqs.q: Is S10.AI good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Not specifically. S10.AI is designed for general medical documentation. Therapists should use Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo). Psychiatrists should consider Freed ($39-119/mo) or mdhub.

faqs.q: S10.AI vs Freed: which is better?
faqs.a: Freed ($39-119/mo) is cheaper. S10.AI ($99/mo) excels at universal EHR compatibility—if your EHR is legacy, non-standard, or has failed integration with other tools, S10.AI's Autopilot approach may work where others don't.
